body.message:
The rate will be AED 8,000 for 1 month (30 nights), and the security deposit will be AED 2,000.

In case you have a pet, an additional AED 2,000 pet fee will apply (non-refundable).

Therefore, the total amount payable will be AED 10,000 (rent + pet fee), plus a AED 2,000 security deposit.
